town_description: Junagadh is a city at the foot of the Girnar hills in the Saurashtra region of Gujarat, once the capital of the former princely state of Junagadh. It is known for the Ashokan rock edicts (c. 250 BCE), the Uparkot fort and the Mahabat Maqbara, and is the gateway for pilgrims climbing Mount Girnar and visitors to Sasan Gir. The district headquarters is a major religious-tourism hub of western Gujarat.
